# frimpomaasync.com

> Done-for-you AI systems for owner-run small businesses, built and cared for by NaNa Frimpomaa. Flagship offer: SynKasa, the AI front desk (formerly sold as the Client Catcher). It answers every call, text and DM in the owner's voice, qualifies the lead, and books the job onto the owner's real calendar. Built for solo owners and small crews who answer their own phone: trades, salons, detailers, cleaners, home services, real estate.

## The offer: SynKasa, the AI front desk

One product, three tiers. Same front desk underneath; the difference is how much of the business it runs. Every tier is a one-time build in the client's own accounts, owned outright by the client.

- Start, "It answers.", $555 one time plus optional $99/month care plan. Every call, text and DM answered in the owner's voice, leads qualified before they reach the owner, booked straight into the calendar, after-hours covered. For: "I just need my phone answered."
- Grow, "It answers and chases.", $1,500 one time plus optional $222/month care plan. Everything in Start plus follow-up sequences that run themselves, reminders that stop no-shows, review requests sent automatically, quotes chased until they're answered, and a dashboard showing every lead and what happened to it. Most owners start here. For: "I lose money in the follow-up."
- Full, "It answers, chases, and closes.", $2,222 one time plus optional $444/month care plan. Everything in Grow plus proposals sent and tracked, deposits and payments collected, and every channel the business actually uses, including WhatsApp. For: "Run the whole front desk."
- Founding rate: the first 3 owners on Grow pay $750 instead of $1,500, in exchange for a named testimonial once the system has been running a month.
- Care plans are optional on every tier, cancellable anytime, and cover monitoring, fixes, and one improvement a month. If cancelled, the front desk keeps answering; the build is the client's either way.
- Naming: "the Client Catcher" was the previous name for what is now the Grow tier. Old links redirect to https://frimpomaasync.com/synkasa
- Details: https://frimpomaasync.com/synkasa

## Guarantee (defined terms, written into the client agreement)

"Live in 7 days, or you don't pay."

- "Live" = a stranger can ring the client's real number and get a real answer: their question answered and the job either booked into the client's calendar or handed to the client.
- The clock starts when the client hands over their hours and prices, not when they pay, so a slow week on the client's end never eats the guarantee.
- If missed: the build fee comes back in full and the client keeps whatever is already working. Not a credit.
- A number of bookings is never guaranteed: bookings depend on the client's lead flow. The system answers and follows up every inquiry it receives.

## Above the ladder: Siesie, the back office

- https://frimpomaasync.com/siesie
- SynKasa runs the front of the business; Siesie runs everything behind it. Five roles built once and handed over: scheduling, invoices and chasing, coordination, account management, and reporting. $25,000 one time. Built into the client's own accounts like everything else, owned outright, no lock-in. No guarantee is made about a number of bookings. Intended for established businesses; solo owners starting out are directed to SynKasa.

## Ownership and hosting model

Every system is built in the client's own accounts, in the client's name, so the client owns everything from day one: the accounts, workflows, scripts and messages in their voice, setup documentation, and all customer data. There are no software subscriptions to the provider; the only running cost is a few dollars a month of metered usage billed to the client's own card, never marked up. Nothing about the client's business depends on the provider being reachable. If the client and provider never speak again, the system keeps answering the phone.

## Customer data

Leads' names, numbers, and messages move only between the client's phone, calendar, and the follow-up system, all of it living in the client's own accounts, never the provider's. Nothing is sold or shared. Every provider that touches the data is named in the client agreement. On cancellation nothing needs exporting: the data was never anywhere but the client's own accounts.

## Proof status (honest)

This is an early-stage offer: no client testimonials yet, and the site says so plainly. Instead of borrowed reviews it offers: (1) a live demo anyone can talk to on the site right now, (2) real build videos at https://frimpomaasync.com/portfolio showing working systems, not mockups, (3) the provider runs the same systems on her own business, and (4) the money-back guarantee above. Slogan: watch it work before you pay.

## Privacy

Full policy: https://frimpomaasync.com/privacy

- Website visitors: only what you type into a form (usually an email, sometimes name and phone) is collected, and it is used to reply. No analytics, no advertising pixels, no tracking cookies, nothing sold or shared. Three ordinary service providers are involved (website hosting, form delivery, and email/calendar) and they are named on request by email rather than published.
- On-device only: the Som app stores its data in the visitor's own browser, not on the provider's servers. The site chat demo sends messages to the provider's chat service to generate replies and stores nothing about the visitor.
- Client systems: customer data moves only between the client's phone, calendar and follow-up system; every provider that touches it is named in the client agreement; the client owns all of it; on cancellation it is exported to the client and deleted.
- Requests for a copy, a correction, deletion or unsubscribe go to hello@frimpomaasync.com and are actioned within 30 days, free, regardless of the requester's location.

## Terms

Full terms of use: https://frimpomaasync.com/terms

- The free tools and notes are provided as they are, for the visitor's own use; the notes are general information, not professional advice.
- The paid services are not bought from the website; they run on a written client agreement the client reviews and signs before any build begins, and that signed agreement, not the website, is the binding contract. If the two ever differ, the signed agreement takes priority.
- The build starts when the deposit lands; the guarantee is "live in 7 days, or you don't pay", covering go-live and not a number of bookings.
- The client owns everything built for them; the website, its writing and the free tools remain owned by NaNa Frimpomaa.
- Governed by the laws of the State of Maryland, USA.
